environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in isolated private subnets (no NAT, no IGW route) with awsvpcConfiguration assignPublicIp=DISABLED. Service discovery via AWS Cloud Map (namespace: internal.prod.local). Ingress exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with endpoint policy restricting Principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/authorized-consumer-role. Security group on ENI allows inbound only from sg-0fedcba9876543210 (the consumer service's SG) on port 4000. No internet gateway, no NAT gateway, no VPC peering to any VPC with internet access. Route table for subnet has only local VPC CIDR route (10.0.48.0/20 -> local). Task IAM role has no network-related permissions. REQUIRE_AUTH=true with token validation against internal OIDC provider reachable via separate VPC endpoint.
